flags.old: A burning fortress under a great bell. A mossy field where a long hill seems to breathe. A river, a white ward, a frozen forest.
flags.problem: The panel is a row of rifts, and the line inventories them as a five-item list of fragments, which the style rules out, while spending the river and the ward that P20 and P21 show close up a beat later.
flags.new: Every rift is a door to a different world. A fortress burns under a great bell, and in a green field, a long hill seems to breathe.

art_vs_script.note: No small cyan window floats in front of Jaeha, though the art text asks for one; P01 has no ui entry, so nothing will be composited there either.
In the Call Jaeha wears black lace-up boots, but on the bed he is in socks (P01, P02, P41) and the continuity says he looks exactly as he does on the bed; P38 and P39 show socks in the Call.
The ring has about twelve rifts here, against eight in P17 and P19 (the script's five places and three dark rifts).
A whole stone face fills the frame, with brows, a nose and eyes already half open; the script asks only for two eyes under heavy stone-grey lids in the moss, beginning to open.
